title: Addition of the Adaptor to RNA Substrates for 3′ RACE
author: Matus Valach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xssfnee

steps.title: Prepare 10 µL adaptor ligation mix
steps.instruction: Combine the required components for adaptor ligation in a total volume of 10 µL; ensure the 3′ end of the 3′ RACE oligo is blocked (e.g., with a 3′ inverted‑dT or 3′ dideoxy modification) and follow the separate protocol for 5′ pre‑adenylation if needed.

steps.title: Denature mixture and chill on ice
steps.instruction: Heat the 10 µL mixture at 70 °C for 2 minutes, then immediately place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Add T4 RNA Ligase 2 (20 µL total)
steps.instruction: Add T4 RNA Ligase 2, truncated KQ (NEB #M0373; the non‑KQ version NEB #M0242 may also be used) to the chilled mixture to bring the reaction volume to 20 µL and mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate ligation reaction with temperature program
steps.instruction: Incubate the 20 µL ligation mixture for 60 minutes at 25 °C, then 60 minutes at 16 °C, and finally 120 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify ligated RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA from the ligation reaction using a suitable method such as Trizol extraction or a column‑based clean‑up.

steps.title: Perform RT‑PCR with adaptor‑ligated RNA
steps.instruction: Use 250–500 ng of the purified adaptor‑ligated RNA for reverse transcription with a primer reverse‑complementary to the 3′ adaptor; then amplify by PCR using a forward primer that binds the RNA of interest and a reverse primer that binds the 3′ adaptor.
